items.title: Interpres
items.summary: Privacy-first Live Captions companion for Deaf and hard-of-hearing users — saves what Windows and Mac Live Captions already show, fully local.
items.description: Interpres works with OS Live Captions (not a stand-alone speech engine). Native Win32 and AppKit UIs, opt-in dated session transcripts, light/dark/system theme, and a strict zero crates.io Rust core. Portable Mac and Windows builds; no subscription or cloud account.
items.imageAlt: Interpres on Mac — native companion window with Live and Session caption areas

items.title: AgentVideoParse
items.summary: Drop a short debug video (≤30s) and get ordered frame screenshots so AI coding agents can see what was on screen.
items.description: Agents read stills well but struggle with video. AgentVideoParse rejects clips over 30 seconds on purpose, samples agent-friendly JPEGs, and writes a manifest. Native macOS (SwiftUI + AVFoundation) and Windows (WPF) apps with a unified shell — no Python required for end users. Fully local, MIT.
items.imageAlt: AgentVideoParse on macOS — unified dark UI for short debug video export

items.title: AgentGifParse
items.summary: Drop a short animated GIF (≤30s) and get ordered frame screenshots so AI agents can review motion without watching the loop.
items.description: Sibling to AgentVideoParse for GIF-only workflows. Hard 30s reject, 2 fps sampling (max 60 stills), agent-friendly JPEGs, and a manifest. Useful when short loops come from UI bugs or generative tools (Imagine-class / Seedance-style GIF and clip exports). Native macOS (SwiftUI + ImageIO) and Windows (WPF + WIC) apps; fully local, MIT.
items.imageAlt: AgentGifParse on macOS — unified dark UI for short animated GIF export

items.title: Wikifier
items.summary: A token-efficient codebase map for AI agents — health matrix, dependency graphs, and per-file summaries so agents look things up instead of re-reading source.
items.description: Wikifier gives coding agents a living map of any codebase: documentation health, dependency analysis (Python and JS/TS), circular dependency detection, and MCP tools so agents query a short summary instead of ingesting whole files. Pure Python stdlib, zero runtime dependencies.
items.imageAlt: Wikifier dashboard showing health matrix and dependency graph

items.title: CoordinationHub
items.summary: A shared coordination layer so multiple AI coding agents don’t overwrite each other — file locks, agent tree, tasks, and a live dashboard.
items.description: CoordinationHub tracks which agents are active, who holds which files, and which tasks are blocked. TTL locks, scope boundaries, messaging, and an SVG dashboard over SSE. Built for multi-agent local workflows with MCP and Claude Code hooks. Pure Python stdlib.
items.imageAlt: CoordinationHub dashboard with agents, tasks, and file locks

items.title: Chisel
items.summary: Test impact analysis for LLM agents — maps tests to code, scores risk, and suggests what to run after a change.
items.description: Chisel maps the blast radius of code changes across many languages and test frameworks. Agents get targeted test suggestions, risk scores, and ownership signals instead of guessing. CLI, HTTP, and MCP. Pure Python with SQLite.
items.imageAlt: Chisel risk map and test impact analysis UI

items.title: Grok-Bevy
items.summary: MCP server + CLI so AI coding agents can doctor, scaffold, and live-control Bevy 2D/3D games — BRP query/mutate and viewport screenshots.
items.description: Gives agents eyes and hands on a running Bevy app: environment doctor, 2D/3D scaffolds, live Bevy Remote Protocol control, and viewport capture. Works with Grok Build and any MCP client. Dual-licensed MIT or Apache-2.0.
items.imageAlt: Crystal Drift gameplay — mining drone, asteroids, score and fuel HUD

items.title: stele-context
items.summary: Local context cache for LLM agents with hybrid search, multi-agent safety, and MCP tools — runs fully offline.
items.description: stele-context caches chunked project context so agents avoid re-reading unchanged files. Hybrid vector + keyword search, symbol graph, and locking for multi-agent use. Pure Python, optional tree-sitter, 100% offline capable.

items.title: Trammel
items.summary: Planning and execution harness for LLM-assisted coding — dependency-aware strategies, beam search, and learned constraints.
items.description: Trammel decomposes multi-file goals into step sequences, explores strategy variants, verifies incrementally, and caches successful recipes. Designed for agents that need structure, not just chat.

items.title: PythonBol Translator
items.summary: Offline COBOL-to-Python skeleton generator for legacy modernization — validated across thousands of real programs.
items.description: Converts enterprise COBOL into syntactically valid Python skeletons with intrinsic functions, SQL/CICS hints, and copybook resolution. Zero runtime dependencies; includes MCP for agent workflows.
items.imageAlt: PythonBol validation report across COBOL projects

items.title: Checkpoint
items.summary: Browser project book. Today is the home screen — overdue first, then due today. No account.
items.description: A personal project list that runs in the browser. Open a project, type the next task, tap a row to check it off. Export JSON, Markdown, CSV, todo.txt, or a calendar file if you leave. No account, no cloud, no purchase. Use it at checkpointprojects.com.
items.imageAlt: Checkpoint Today view — next, overdue, and due-today tasks in a dark local-first notebook

items.title: ConsistencyHub
items.summary: World-building that catches its own mistakes. Wiki, documents, maps, and continuity checks — files stay in your OneDrive.
items.description: Write chapters, keep a wiki, lay out storyline, and pin maps — all saved to your OneDrive. Heuristic continuity checks run in the browser with no AI required. Prepaid platform Grok is optional for chat, wiki fill, Imagine art, and adventure play. Import from World Anvil, Notion, or Scrivener. Sign in with a personal Microsoft account.
items.imageAlt: ConsistencyHub wiki entity grid with character portraits and letter tiles

items.title: MDWord
items.summary: Live Markdown ↔ Word converter deployed on Netlify for quick document handoffs.
items.description: Browser-based conversion between Markdown and Word documents. Useful when clients and tools disagree on format.

items.title: Console Logger
items.summary: Chromium extension that captures console output across tabs, including errors content scripts miss.
items.description: Uses the debugger API for deep console capture, live popup monitoring, and auto-save to disk. Works on Chromium browsers under Manifest V3.
items.imageAlt: Console Logger extension capturing live console output

items.title: AutoClacker
items.summary: Cross-platform click and keypress automation with Avalonia UI and native platform APIs.
items.description: Configurable intervals, global hotkeys, and persistent settings for Windows, Linux, and macOS. Self-contained builds; no runtime install required.

items.title: Windows Sound Tracker
items.summary: Windows app that logs which processes are making sound in real time.
items.description: Real-time WASAPI-based monitoring with process names, levels, timestamps, CSV logging, and tray support for background use.
